tagline: Architecture-aware Specs, explicit Agent grants and independently checked results.
title: Concorde Framework

homepage.title: Specify the architecture. Guide your agents.
homepage.description: Concorde keeps your project's Specs at the center of AI-assisted development. Your agent reads and selects contracts, answers questions and edits Specs, metadata and registry directly within its grant. Native Pi Agents and Workflows contribute proposals to finite Host acceptance; optional StateGraph Operations are selected separately. Evidence binds to current inputs; direct edits never supply successful review or completion.

features.title: Context and permission, managed around the Spec.

items.title: Read complete Module specifications.
items.description: Module Specs explain purpose, terminology, correct use, design and relationships for a reader who does not know the code. Implementation Specs hold the precise requirements, scenarios and contracts. Paired metadata binds entities to the files that realize them, and tests declare the scenarios they verify.

items.title: Give each domain worker one Module's context.
items.description: A worker receives its Module's own documents and explicit references, one level deep, the vendored documentation of the libraries that Module declares, and its task. Only code-writing and code-review phases read source contents. A missing promise becomes a reported Spec gap, never a guess from code.

items.title: Distinguish grants from enforced isolation.
items.description: Domain Agents have fresh context and terminal tool ceilings. Native file, network and credential restrictions are prompt policy, not OS confinement. Only programmer receives a code-write grant. Configured checks and tester commands separately enforce read-only governing files with writable external scratch; unavailable isolation refuses execution.

items.title: Choose Agents, Workflows or optional Operations.
items.description: An Agent is a callable Pi role, a Workflow is native pi-subagents composition, an Operation is an explicitly selected StateGraph flow, and a Host service is finite deterministic work. Agents defines nine roles as a peer of Operations. Main is the external user Pi session, not a tenth Agent. Genuine Graph Specs remain with their owners.

items.title: Develop in candidate worktrees.
items.description: In consumer projects, a mutating capability requested from primary normally runs in a host-created candidate from the committed base; your session stays in place. Source maintenance uses a fresh catalog-free writer, then main selects independent testing and, when selected, a fresh sibling tester with exact candidate Pi entry, embedded catalog and runtime provenance. Evidence binds current inputs; delivery and primary merging remain separate requests.

items.title: Track problems as Issues.
items.description: Workers record attributed bugs, contract gaps and limitations as Git-versioned Issues. concorde-issues lists, shows, reports, reopens or assesses one selected Issue. Repairs return to the calling agent for authorized edits or explicit capability selection; verification never fabricates completion.

workflow.title: Choose the result you need.
workflow.description: The calling agent chooses the target and order: read and edit the contract directly, then explicitly select context-solve, plan, tasks, implement, independent reviews and validation as needed. There is no automatic authoring, routing or development workflow.

steps.title: Read & select
steps.description: Read complete Module Specs, choose an explicit target, and reconcile authorized Spec, metadata and registry edits directly. Select independent Spec review separately.

steps.title: Plan & implement
steps.description: Confirm the contract suffices, plan and derive tasks from the Spec alone, then write only the Module's listed files.

steps.title: Validate & review
steps.description: Run configured checks and select independent code review. Blocking findings return to the caller, who chooses repair tasks or a stop.

steps.title: Ready, not merged
steps.description: Inspect the candidate. Delivery publishes its branch on request; merging primary needs a separate authorization.

quickstart.title: Start with an explicit project contract.
quickstart.description: Clone and build Concorde, then preview the installation into your Git project. Use Python 3.11+, Node.js 22.6+ with npm and the Pi coding agent with the supported native pi-subagents producer. Linux with bubblewrap is required for enforced check/tester execution, not a claim of native Agent confinement. Pi is the only supported client. Its concorde tool describes and prepares native capabilities or runs finite Host services; initialize the project with concorde-init after installation.
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/FTOD/concorde.git
cd concorde
python3 scripts/concorde.py build

# Replace the path with your Git project.
python3 scripts/install-concorde.py \
  --target /absolute/path/to/project --preview

# Review the preview, then rerun with --apply.

reference.title: Agents and public capabilities
reference.description: Eleven public capability adapters retain their concorde-* names. Agents owns seven domain roles and two outer task roles; consumer packages contain eight definitions, excluding source-only maintenance-worker, and statically register only generic tester. Main remains external. Init, configure, validate and deliver make no model calls; no removed workflow has an alias.

tables.title: Public capabilities
tables.description: Public entries pass common admission. Targeted entries require an explicit Module target. describe-policy previews applicable worker grants without execution; initialization instead uses its deterministic proposal preview.
rows: concorde-context-solve
Assess whether the explicitly selected contract supports the task without editing it.
concorde-plan
Assess current context and produce a revision-bound plan from Specs, not implementation contents.
concorde-tasks
Author acceptance tasks from a current plan; explicitly selected repair feedback must be current.
concorde-implement
Complete admitted local tasks within the listed code grant; return separately selected component work to the caller.
concorde-spec-review
Review the complete Spec and terminology semantic consistency without starting a development change.
concorde-code-review
Review or diagnose the granted implementation against its Spec without starting a development change.
concorde-issues
Inspect or assess an explicit Issue; return repairs to the caller and verify actual current evidence separately.
concorde-init
Propose and apply initialization with a pinned Protocol, the worker model and an honest Module stub.
concorde-configure
Apply explicit Pi worker model, thinking and timeout settings; accept an installed Protocol only when requested.
concorde-validate
Record current deterministic validation evidence for a candidate.
concorde-deliver
Publish a verified delivery branch and normally remove its source worktree; merge primary only on a separate request.

tables.title: Callable Pi roles
tables.description: The Agents Module owns the canonical contracts. Domain roles receive invocation-owned projections; outer task roles receive explicit task/worktree grants rather than domain stage schemas. No role delegates tasks. Registration is discovery, not authority or execution evidence.
rows: spec-reviewer, context-assessor
Review a Spec independently or assess whether its context suffices; read-only.
planner, task-author
Produce plans and acceptance tasks from the Spec, declared references and file names, without source contents.
programmer, code-reviewer
Write only the selected Module's listed files, or review the authorized code read-only in a fresh conversation.
issue-solver
Choose bounded work or an evidence-grounded disposition for one explicitly selected Issue.
maintenance-worker
Source-only author of verified candidate work under main's frozen grant; self-checks are not independent acceptance.
tester
Fresh source/consumer independent tester with read-only governing artifacts, enforced commands and retained evidence; never repairs or delegates.

tables.title: Shared execution services
tables.description: The Operations hierarchy groups behavior providers, including composed providers. Supporting Modules own their separate contracts; using them neither transfers ownership nor expands context references.
rows: Operations
Own explicit StateGraph composition and compatibility capability adapters/dispatch, not the Agent definitions.
Agents
Define all nine callable roles and their interaction, family and distribution scope; main remains an external session.
Harness

Admit requests and native calls, freeze context, enforce terminal tool ceilings and independently accept results. Configured checks/tester commands have separate OS isolation; native file policy is not a sandbox.
Spec
Resolve stable identities, complete paired document units, explicit references and scenario coverage from test declarations.
Distribution
Build fresh worker instructions and the private Pi catalog, install the Pi session tool and provision the managed runtime. No standalone Skills are published or installed.
Issues
Retain attributed problems, assess an explicitly selected Issue, and verify actual caller-selected repairs.
Views
Publish Module Specs and Implementation Specs as a navigable documentation site.

tables.title: Launchers and supporting tools
tables.description: Source-checkout commands are shown below. Installed projects use the corresponding scripts under .concorde/framework/. Direct CLI validation is distinct from lifecycle readiness evidence.
rows: python3 scripts/run-operation.py <operation> < invocation.json
Submit a typed compatibility request. Cognitive capabilities require prepared native Pi transport; bare CLI execution refuses without it.
concorde tool in a Pi session
Describe the eleven public capabilities, prepare exact native calls/workflows, or run finite Host services.
python3 scripts/concorde.py <command>

build, validate, select-session, protocol-manifest, docsite and usage: render assets, check the project, verify exact private Pi provenance, accept a Protocol binding, scaffold a docsite and summarize worker usage.
LangGraph Studio
Inspect the optional terminal Agent StateGraph; execution needs a trusted native launch/admission service, with no public capability mirrors.
python3 scripts/install-concorde.py
Preview or apply Pi-only installation; legacy retirement removes only unchanged receipt-owned outputs and preserves external CLI-owned Skills and user content.
python3 scripts/issues.py
List and show Issues from the command line.
npm --prefix docsite run <script>
Start, build, validate, typecheck or test the documentation site.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest
Run deterministic Python tests in parallel without starting model-backed workers.
